name: hanzo-ai
title: Hanzo AI
description: Hanzo AI in the Raycast command bar — ask Hanzo, and summarize, explain, rewrite, translate, or fix the grammar of your selection or clipboard, wired to the api.hanzo.ai gateway via the published @hanzo/ai.
author: hanzo

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Hanzo
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Ask Hanzo anything, or apply an action to your selection/clipboard, and stream the answer.

commands.name: summarize
commands.title: Summarize
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Summarize the selected text (or clipboard) and copy the summary.

commands.name: explain
commands.title: Explain
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Explain the selected text (or clipboard) in plain language and copy it.

commands.name: rewrite
commands.title: Rewrite
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text and paste it back over the selection.

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Translate the selected text into a target language and paste it back.

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Grammar
commands.subtitle: Hanzo AI
commands.description: Correct grammar, spelling, and punctuation of the selected text and paste it back.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Hanzo API Key
preferences.description: Your Hanzo sk- key from hanzo.id. Stored securely by Raycast; sent only to api.hanzo.ai.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Default model id routed by the api.hanzo.ai gateway. Override per request in Ask Hanzo.
